notes: The second player attempt can use any changed valid allocation, even a more uneven one. No title, player thought or Run condition forces a more balanced split. The inclusive near-even spread remains 10 percentage points.

After two attempts, mixed patterns compare directly; two uneven attempts offer What if they counted equally?, and two near-even attempts offer What if one counted more?. System references require a click and the same manual Observe flow.

Comparison displays every actual run in order, including both player attempts and a system reference. Browser checks cover all three cards on desktop and 320px with exact tested snapshots, including the 76/6/18 to 80/10/10 case.

Findings group all selected metrics by actual qualitative effort category. Both Participation and Focus are named as minimum effort for 76/6/18. Score weights are smaller and muted; effort labels and bars are prominent. No exact numerical effort or learning result is inferred.

Teacher observations/plans have cloud thought bubbles and Thinking accessibility. Spoken questions keep ordinary bubbles. Each Level 3 workbench beat has two short independent Alex messages; source emoji remain distinct.

The preview ends on the final Goodhart theory placeholder. There is no Design Lab destination, completion screen or final navigation button. Reserved onDesignLab is never called, including by duplicate cinematic completion callbacks.

Restart controls and dialogs are removed from all three player entries; administrator functionality is deferred by user instruction. Reset weights only resets the current allocation. Fresh/reloaded/restored-page behavior remains unchanged.

Ordinary metric names are 16px throughout. Shared tokens align equivalent chapter, step, description, dialogue, perspective, student-behaviour, evidence and scene-caption roles. Actual production selection pages match across all three chapters at 1366, 390 and 320px and do not overflow. Narrative intro text and warning emphasis retain their intended distinct roles.

The real Gameplay host retains opening identity, original Level 2 choices and sound preference into Level 3; players can swap preselected metrics. Level 1/2 name, custom-scene, no-restart, storage-blocked, hidden-page and 320px integration checks passed.

All four current entries were rebuilt together. The added Level3-and-Full-game-play.zip contains Level3/Level3.html and Full-game/Gaming-the-System.html, byte-identical to the individual latest tested downloads. The manifest records all source/build/archive/review hashes.

Managed Chromium tests exact offline production bytes through an in-memory HTTPS origin because local file navigation is blocked. Direct file opening in the user browser, a classroom load test, finished partner videos and an administrator login are not claimed.

Historical validation reports and version-numbered ZIPs remain unchanged. The broad historical Level 2 presentation suite was updated for removal of the retired Restart UI; its broad timing run is not counted here. Current Level 2 integration, identity, package and typography suites were executed.
